schedule.priority: critical chain first, then the members and ancestors of priority gates (G2), then rank (ascending latest_start), then natural id; gate_order strict: a gate block starts when every earlier block has merged

assumptions: Agent hours are S=4, M=7, L=11, XL=16 unless the ticket has hours.
Each approval for a size not in autoMergeSizes is provided within 30 minutes.
Each blocking gate check is signed within 30 minutes.
Sizes in autoMergeSizes add no human wait. The default list is S, M.
Elapsed hours are the longer of the critical chain plus those waits, and agent hours divided by maxAgents.

acs.text: Given each of the sixteen statuses in SPEC §5.1, when catOf runs, then it returns the category listed there; merged, done and skipped are 'done'; awaiting_approval is 'qa'; alarm, parked and blocked are 'err'.

WV-07.summary: Planned swimlane and actual timeline layouts

plan.body: Port the reference dashboard's plan(), layoutPlan() and layoutActual() into app/src/model/plan/plan.mjs as pure functions (SPEC 7, 8): as-written path for schedules and beams whose tickets carry planned slot/start/merge, list-scheduling simulation otherwise (critical, starred, priority gate, rank, downstream chain, natural id; strict block order for beams). Unreachable tickets are laid out after everything and flagged unplaced, with an iteration guard. layoutActual takes now as a parameter. Tests in plan.test.mjs use an inline fixture loader because the load/parse module is outside these locks.

result.body: plan.test.mjs: 14 tests green. Exact equality with view.plan.json, big.plan.json, schedule.plan.json, two-repos.plan.json and view.actual.json. Full suite 48/48 green. Only lock paths changed.
